drivers.summary: VOC port/fort control becomes competing coastal sovereignty.

consequences.summary: Registers, litigation and categories deepen administrative reach.

protagonists.name: Kandyan monarchy
protagonists.objective: Use the VOC against Portugal without losing the coast.

protagonists.name: VOC Ceylon
protagonists.objective: Turn conquered coastal nodes into defensible revenue and administration.

what_changed: The ally becomes a coastal sovereign competitor.
Military nodes become an administrative-fiscal system.

prepares_next.bullet: A stronger paper-and-fort state enters an Indian Ocean system that is becoming increasingly asymmetric in Britain's favour.
